sizing_gate.verdict: over-threshold, proceeding by explicit operator decision
sizing_gate.note: 8 changed files (5 code + 3 test) across 2 concerns (routing, retry logging) trips the >6-files / multiple-concerns split recommendation. The split was offered in the Phase 2 interview ('ship the retry half now, hold the routing half') and the operator redirected twice: first choosing a single hotfix off deploy, then clearing the routing half's blocker by deferring is_visible. Recorded rather than re-asked. NARROWED 2026-09-17: the Hits half was split to DEV-2614 at the operator's direction after review round 2 flagged the unreconciled ListHits ClickHouse query. ListHits is no longer in the diff.

subtasks.title: Take the Postgres/ClickHouse routing decision off Pennant (SCANS ONLY)
subtasks.approach: Replace Feature::active('clickhouse:scans') with a direct config() read at the two SCANS call sites, keeping the admin_impersonator escape hatch. ListHits is out of scope (DEV-2614).
subtasks.intended_diffs: ListScans::shouldUseClickhouse() -> config('app.experimental.clickhouse.scans', false) || session()->has('admin_impersonator'). ListHits::shouldUseClickhouse() -> config('app.experimental.clickhouse.hits', false) || (its existing extra conditions). ScanVehicleController:25 -> config('app.experimental.clickhouse.scans', false) || session()->has('admin_impersonator'). NOTE: ListScans still uses Feature::active(FeatureEnum::SHARED_KITS->slug()) at :328 and others at :130/:179 - do NOT remove its Feature import.

subtasks.title: De-amplify HasRetryQuery logging and reduce retryUntil
subtasks.approach: Guard the Log::channel('db-error') + logDatadogCount('clarity.query_timeout') pair behind a component property holding a hash of the current filter state, so the pair fires once per distinct failed search and re-arms when the filter set changes. Separately set retryUntil = 1.
subtasks.intended_diffs: Add a public string property (e.g. $lastLoggedFailureKey = '') alongside $retryCount. In the catch(QueryException) branch compute a key from the current table filter state; log + increment only when the key differs from the stored one, then store it. retryUntil: 2 -> 1. Both the log and the metric move behind the same guard - they must not diverge, since the ticket's 5.96x figure is measured off both.

subtasks.title: Reconcile ClickHouse scan kit scoping with the Postgres path
subtasks.approach: Mirror App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit::scopeForKits onto App\Clickhouse\Models\Scan, then have ListScans::buildClickhouseQuery() scope by the same kit id list buildPostgresQuery() resolves via forOrg($orgId, withSharedKits: ...), instead of org_id alone.
subtasks.intended_diffs: Clickhouse\Scan: add scopeForKits(Builder $q, array $kitIds) following Hit::scopeForKits exactly. ListScans::buildClickhouseQuery(): replace ->forOrg((int) auth()->user()->org_id) with the kit-id list, resolved the same way buildPostgresQuery() does (Kit::getKits with the SHARED_KITS feature check) so both paths agree. Do NOT add ->final().

subtasks.title: Tests
subtasks.approach: Pin the routing decision, the no-FINAL invariant, the kit-scoping parity (by query shape), and the log/metric dedup.
subtasks.intended_diffs: HasRetryQueryTest: repeated failures under one filter state log once; a filter change re-arms and logs again; retryUntil = 1 stops the poll after one retry. ScansResourceTest/HitsResourceTest: shouldUseClickhouse() follows config only (true when config true regardless of Pro tier, false when config false even for a Pro org, true for admin_impersonator regardless); buildClickhouseQuery() emits no FINAL and scopes by the kit list.

excluded_sites.reason: Same 'clickhouse:hits' literal mismatch, deliberately left in place. Split to DEV-2614: the routing fix is coupled to reconciling the ClickHouse Hits query, which filters only kit_id on a table whose sort key leads with hotlist_org_id.
Bare 'ai-notifications' literal that happens to equal Str::slug('AI Notifications'). Same brittle idiom, but correct today and unrelated to this ticket's failure mode. Follow-up, not drive-by drift.

The two Feature::define() lines become unreferenced once routing is config-only. Left in place deliberately for a hotfix; removing a define has its own risk surface (UnknownFeatureResolved for any future caller) and was not part of the operator's decision.
CLICKHOUSE_SCANS/CLICKHOUSE_HITS remain bundled in CLARITY_PRO/CLARITY_PRO_PLUS. Changing ProTierEnum was explicitly rejected by the operator as too risky.
makeOrgPro/makeUserPro exclude CLICKHOUSE_SCANS (but not CLICKHOUSE_HITS). Once routing is config-only these exclusions no longer affect routing, so they are inert rather than wrong. Not touched.
